{{Quote|A little something I picked up from my pal, Needles, best street racer in all of Corellia. Till he crashed and died, doing this.|Han Solo, before attempting Needles' maneuver|<ref name="Solo" />}}
'''Needles''' was a [[Gender|male]] individual who was a friend of [[Han Solo]]. According to Solo, Needles was the best street [[racer]] on [[Corellia]]. At some point before [[10 BBY]], Needles attempted to pull a dangerous maneuver whilst driving a vehicle, but it failed and he was [[Death|killed]]. Whilst [[Raid on Kessel|escaping]] from the [[Galactic Empire]] in the [[Maw Cluster]], Solo and the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] successfully performed the same move Needles attempted.<ref name="Solo" />

==Behind the scenes==
Needles was first mentioned in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''. The film's co-writer [[Jon Kasdan]] revealed on his [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] account that Needles' name is a reference to [[W:c:backtothefuture:Douglas J. Needles|Douglas J. Needles]] (portrayed by ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' actor [[Flea (actor)|Flea]]), a character who appeared in the [[Wikipedia:Back to the Future Part II|second]] and [[Wikipedia:Back to the Future Part III|third films]] of the [[Wikipedia:Back to the Future (franchise)|''Back to the Future'' trilogy]].<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|JonKasdan|status/1000259740331474944|[[Jon Kasdan]]|quote=NEEDLES is 100% a reference to BACK TO THE FUTURE III. Don't race Needles! It'll ruin your life!|date=2018-05-25|archivedate=20200814122915}} {{C|Note: The original tweet has been taken offline}}</ref>
